prompt: Create only the Japanese password-reset completion component LH06-0038 at its 390×276 display frame. Reference 1 controls the original success-mark anatomy; reference 2 controls the exact crop, Japanese copy, ordering and layout. Keep the same hierarchy and wrapping as the Japanese mock. Preserve the source success icon as one forest-green circular mark with a white check, without adding a pale-green background wash. Keep 「リンクを再送」 as a modest underlined forest-green text link, not a filled button. Use the established native typography roles: Meiryo Bold 20/28 heading, Meiryo Regular 14/24 body, and Meiryo Regular 12/16 supporting copy/link. Do not include phone status/navigation chrome, the back control, app logo/footer, an email address, device frame, added copy or extra container. Output only this compact component on pure white.
